378YE Spring Equinox winds of war.d: In the east, Imperial forces took Kopevnost, Moresvah and Nitrost in Karsk but suffered heavy casualties. In Holberg, a Druj army under the Scorpion's Sting held Rebeshof and the Ennerlund mines, and only risen dead fighting beside the Winter Sun prevented disaster. The Druj fought each other in the Barrens. In Therunin, nearly a thousand Navarr fell as ten thousand orcs closed on Peakedge Stand. In Spiral, defenders held the Ossuary against orcs under no known Grendel banner. In the west, the Hounds of Glory struck Segura, and the Summer Storm freed Treji, though Harak the Red escaped. Lasambrians raided Liathaven, and Jotun raiders wore down the Greensward.

n.Dawn: Dawnish knights and war-witches marched with the Hounds of Glory to relieve Segura, and Dawn's scouts reported Druj banners burning in the Barrens.
n.Druj: The Druj held Holberg to a stalemate and pushed into Therunin, yet their armies fought one another in the Barrens, and orcs left Brocéliande to answer some call there.
n.Grendel: The orcs fighting in Spiral bore no known Grendel banner, and they were denied the Ossuary despite holding the advantage.
n.Highguard: Highborn forces helped turn back the orc assault on the Ossuary in Spiral, and Necropolis lay on the route of the army marching to Segura.
n.Jotun: The Jotun treaty in the Mournwold still held, but Jotun raiders were grinding down the Greensward, and their campaign of capture in the Mourn was reported complete.
n.Navarr: The Black Thorns were slowly driven back in Therunin with nearly a thousand Navarri dead, and Navarr in Liathaven were isolated against Lasambrian raiders. Navarr from three Hercynian regions helped liberate Treji.
n.The Brass Coast: An Imperial army came to the defence of the Brass Coast, relieving Anozel, burning Lasambrian camps and reclaiming farms across Segura.
n.The League: Two walls of Holberg were united under the Empire again, but the Imperial advance there was fought to a standstill, and Sarvos lay on the route to Segura.
n.The Marches: The folk of the Greensward were being slowly ground down by Jotun raiders, though the treaty in the Mournwold still held.
n.Thule: The Thule were driven out of Karsk and abandoned their Isember allies. In Hercynia, prisoners forced to make arms for the Thule were freed.
n.Urizen: Urizen's Granite Pillar and Quiet Step held Spiral, allowing work on the Fist to resume while Ateri's stone-crafters laboured on the fortress of Mezudan.
n.Varushka: Imperial armies retook Kopevnost, Moresvah and Nitrost in Karsk with the help of Moresvah's miners, though the cost in casualties was heavy.
n.Wintermark: Mentioned in passing: the Summer Storm struck into Hercynia from the hills of Skarsind.

t.Brocéliande: Large numbers of orcs left their hideaways in Brocéliande, slipping past patrols to cross east into the Barrens.
t.Hercynia: The Summer Storm caught the orcs in the Glade of Shadows unprepared and liberated the near-ruined Treji, freeing many prisoners, though Harak the Red escaped.
t.Holberg: Imperial attacks on Druj fortifications were repeatedly repulsed, and only an army of risen dead fighting with the Winter Sun prevented heavy losses, leaving the territory stalemated.
t.Karsk: The Thule were decisively defeated and driven east, leaving all three regions in Imperial control and the Isember traitors exposed.
t.Liathaven: A Lasambrian army moved northward unopposed, burning steadings and slaughtering stridings among Navarr who were cut off from the Empire.
t.Madruga: Mentioned in passing: the Imperial army passed through Madruga before crossing the Scorrero into Segura.
t.Mournwold: The Jotun treaty still held, but no more refugees were coming out of the Mourn, and the Jotun campaign there had entered a new phase.
t.Necropolis: Mentioned in passing: the army bound for Segura set out from Necropolis.
t.Reikos: Mentioned in passing: the two Druj armies attacking Therunin fought across the border from Reikos.
t.Sarvos: Mentioned in passing: Sarvos lay on the army's route from Necropolis to Segura.
t.Segura: The Imperial army relieved Anozel and drove the Lasambrians out of the Sobral Grasses and Anozeseri, leaving them retreating across the Iron Plains.
t.Skarsind: Mentioned in passing: the Summer Storm rampaged down from the hills of Skarsind into Hercynia.
t.Spiral: The Imperial defenders denied the orcs the Ossuary and claimed its mithril, while work resumed on the Fist and the fortress of Mezudan.
t.The Barrens: Druj armies fought pitched battles against each other, and watchers from Drycastle and the Towers of the Dawn saw Druj banners burning.
t.Therunin: Outnumbered two to one, the Black Thorns were slowly driven back with nearly a thousand dead, and ten thousand orcs were closing on the refugee haven of Peakedge Stand.

r.Hercynia/Northpines: Mentioned in passing: the Navarr of Northpines supported the Imperial orcs in liberating Treji.
r.Hercynia/Old Ranging: Mentioned in passing: the Navarr of Old Ranging supported the Imperial orcs in liberating Treji.
r.Hercynia/Summersend: Mentioned in passing: the Navarr of Summersend supported the Imperial orcs in liberating Treji.
r.Holberg/Ennerlund: The Druj clung grimly to the Mines at Ennerlund.
r.Holberg/Holfried: A wailing wind swept across the battlefields of Holfried, and the dead rose from their graves to fight beneath the Winter Sun's banner.
r.Holberg/Rebeshof: Imperial assaults broke again and again against the Scorpion's Sting's fortifications at Rebeshof.
r.Karsk/Kopevnost: Kopevnost came under Imperial control after decisive victories over the Thule.
r.Karsk/Moresvah: Moresvah's grateful miners aided the Imperial armies, and the region came under Imperial control.
r.Karsk/Nitrost: Nitrost came under Imperial control as the Thule fell back eastward.
r.Liathaven/Beacon Point: Lasambrian hillborn barbarians worked their way northward through the trees of Beacon Point.
r.Liathaven/Western Scout: Lasambrian scouts pushed into Western Scout, where isolated Navarr faced burning steadings and theft.
r.Mournwold/Greensward: The folk of the Greensward were being slowly ground down by raiding barbarians.
r.Segura/Anozeseri: The Imperial campaign, joined by freedom fighters from Morajasse, drove the Lasambrians out of Anozeseri and reclaimed farm after farm.
r.Segura/Iron Plains: The Lasambrians attempted a desperate retreat across the Iron Plains, where the first engagements went to the Empire.
r.Segura/Sobral Grasses: The Lasambrian camps in the Sobral Grasses were burnt.
r.Spiral/Ateri: Ateri's stone-crafters' guild worked feverishly on the fortress of Mezudan, which might yet draw the barbarians' ire.
r.Spiral/Ossuary: The Imperial forces turned back the barbarians seeking to conquer the Ossuary and claimed the mithril mined from the Legacy.

Amend conditions of Brock's Buffet.d: Brock's Toll, a National Bourse position (a sinecure) in Miaren, is held by whoever wins Brock's Buffet, an annual competition of arms between yeomen of Dawn and the Marches. The senator for Miaren proposed changing the conditions so that the Navarr could field contestants and potentially win custodianship of the toll bridge themselves. The motion was seconded by the senator for Therunin. It was put to the Senate at the Spring Equinox 378YE and was defeated in principle by 6 votes to 22, leaving the contest open only to Dawnish and Marcher yeomen.

n.Dawn: Dawnish yeomen kept their place as one of only two contenders for Brock's Toll, with no new Navarr rivals admitted to the contest.
n.Navarr: The Navarr attempt, led by the senators for Miaren and Therunin, to win a place in Brock's Buffet and a chance at the toll bridge in their own territory was defeated.

t.Miaren: Although Brock's Toll lies in Navarr-held Miaren, the failed motion meant its custodianship would still be decided solely between Dawnish and Marcher yeomen.

Appoint Feverwater Dredgemaster.d: This procedural Senate motion assigned a person to the position of Dredgemaster of Lake Feverwater, with the nomination falling to the Navarr senators. The position was a sinecure in Feverwater lake in Therunin, created by an earlier Senate motion that permitted the dredging of Feverwater. The election was a national one, run by the master of elections and involving only the Navarr senators. There was a single nominee, Corey Brackensong, who was appointed by unanimous decision of the Navarri senators.

n.Navarr: Navarr's senators held the right to nominate the Dredgemaster and unanimously chose Corey Brackensong, placing the new Feverwater sinecure in Navarri hands.

t.Therunin: Therunin's Lake Feverwater gained its first Dredgemaster, Corey Brackensong, to hold the sinecure created when the Senate permitted the lake's dredging.

Archive:378YE Spring Equinox Imperial ti.d: The list named the senators for each territory, Senate appointees such as the Conscience of the Senate, Gideon, and the sinecure holders. It also named the Military Council's generals, the Warmage Vaan of Auric Horizon and the Quartermaster General. The Synod's cardinals and gatekeepers, the High Exorcist and the Auditor of Senatorial Accountability appeared, as did the six Archmagi and the Grandmasters of the Orders. Bourse seats were listed with their winning bids. New generals took command of the Fire of the South, the Winter Sun, the Wolves of War and the Quiet Step. The Mitwold Senate seat was vacant. The Great Forest at Reikos and the Great Pits of Ennerlund remained in Druj hands and would not be auctioned until those territories were Imperial again.

n.Dawn: Dawn's senators were Bohemond De Rondell, Ywain De Gauvain and Lady Adia of House Arwood, and its generals were Floree de Rondell, Clarence Oswald and Frederick Novarion. Dawn also held the Vigilance and Wisdom cardinalships, and Maurice de Gauvain was Archmage of Autumn.
n.Druj: The Druj were recorded as holding the Great Forest at Reikos and the Great Pits of Ennerlund, which would not be auctioned while those territories remained in their hands.
n.Highguard: Highguard's senators were Solomon, Zephram and Adamah, and its generals were Matthias, Ruth and Tyrus. Highguard also held the Courage, Loyalty and Pride cardinalships, and Gideon of the Suns of Couros was Conscience of the Senate.
n.Imperial Orcs: General Bloodcrow Martok replaced Klor as commander of the Winter Sun, and Braka continued to lead the Summer Storm. The Steel Fist was held by Irontide Vio.
n.Navarr: Navarr's senators were Rhain, Rhys and Caerwyn Summer Crow, and General Gwai replaced Kale Vigil in command of the Quiet Step. Meurig Tystwarden remained Gatekeeper of the Pride Assembly, and Meir Pathfinder was Grandmaster of the Rod and Shield.
n.The Brass Coast: The Brass Coast's three senators were listed, and General Anwar i Covas i Erigo replaced Yasmina i Ezmara i Erigo at the head of the Fire of the South. Freeborn also held the Prosperity gatekeepership and the Grandmastery of the Golden Pyramid.
n.The League: The League's senators were Mirislav, Cesare Sanguineo and Drogon Morosini, and General Gabriel Barossa replaced Stanislav Krieger in command of the Wolves of War. League citizens also held the Prosperity cardinalship, the post of Quartermaster General and many Bourse seats.
n.The Marches: The Marcher senators were Orrick for Bregasland and Henry Ward for Upwold, while the Mitwold seat stood vacant. Its generals were Richard Talbot, Jack Flint and William Tanner.
n.Thule: Mentioned in passing: Thule is not named; its only link is Karsk, which it held, though the page still listed a senator for Karsk among Varushka's senators.
n.Urizen: Urizen's senators were Lucius, Probus and Cato, and General Tanwyn Ankarien led the Citadel Guard. Urizeni also held the Courage and Wisdom gatekeeperships, the post of High Exorcist and the Legacy.
n.Varushka: Varushka's senators were listed for Karsk, Karov, Miekarova and Volodmartz, and its generals were Olaf Gregorson Strascovich and Stanislav Borodin Havel. Varushkans also served as Auditor of Senatorial Accountability, Dean of the Lyceum and Grandmasters of two Orders.
n.Wintermark: Wintermark's four senators were listed, and its generals were Vahne and Erkenbrand of Tyrsholm. Eofric Sammersund Miksa was Cardinal of Ambition, and Wintermark held the Stonefield Ice Caves and the Brilliant Shore.

t.Bastion: Mentioned in passing: Solomon is listed as Bastion's senator.
t.Bregasland: Mentioned in passing: Orrick is listed as senator for Bregasland, the Dour Fens.
t.Casinea: Mentioned in passing: Zephram of Cantiarch's Hold is listed as Casinea's senator.
t.Feroz: Mentioned in passing: Sallur i Mnajdra i Guerra is listed as Feroz's senator.
t.Hahnmark: Mentioned in passing: Hengest Dun is listed as Hahnmark's senator.
t.Hercynia: Mentioned in passing: Rhain is listed as Hercynia's senator.
t.Holberg: Holberg had no senator listed, and its Great Pits of Ennerlund would not be auctioned until Holberg was once again an Imperial territory.
t.Kahraman: Mentioned in passing: Rauul i Jannat i Riqueza is listed as Kahraman's senator.
t.Kallavesa: Mentioned in passing: Uskolli is listed as Kallavesa's senator.
t.Karov: Mentioned in passing: Constantin is listed as Karov's senator.
t.Karsk: Mentioned in passing: Machek Winterborn is listed as senator for Karsk among Varushka's senators, although Karsk was held by Thule.
t.Madruga: Mentioned in passing: Avisena i Ezmara i Guerra is listed as Madruga's senator.
t.Miaren: Mentioned in passing: Rhys is listed as Miaren's senator.
t.Miekarova: Mentioned in passing: Radomir is listed as Miekarova's senator.
t.Mitwold: Mitwold's Senate seat was recorded as vacant.
t.Morrow: Mentioned in passing: Lucius of Quicksilver Spire is listed as Morrow's senator.
t.Necropolis: Mentioned in passing: Adamah of the Silent Tide is listed as Necropolis's senator.
t.Redoubt: Mentioned in passing: Probus is listed as Redoubt's senator.
t.Reikos: Reikos had no senator listed, and its Great Forest, held by the Druj, would not be auctioned until Reikos was once again Imperial.
t.Sarvos: Mentioned in passing: Mirislav is listed as Sarvos's senator.
t.Semmerholm: Mentioned in passing: Ywain De Gauvain is listed as Semmerholm's senator.
t.Sermersuaq: Mentioned in passing: Atte is listed as Sermersuaq's senator.

t.Upwold: Mentioned in passing: Henry Ward is listed as senator for Upwold, the Silver Chase.

t.Weirwater: Mentioned in passing: Lady Adia of House Arwood is listed as Weirwater's senator, and the Weirwater Vales Bourse seat was held by Niccolo dos Tassatos for 98 Thrones.
t.Zenith: Mentioned in passing: Cato is listed as Zenith's senator.

r.Holberg/Ennerlund: The Great Pits of Ennerlund were held by the Druj and would not be auctioned until Holberg was once again an Imperial territory.

Assignment of Karsk.d: Karsk was conquered after a heroic opportunity in the region of Lestasny, so the Senate had to decide which Imperial nation would take it. The procedural vote went 26 to 0 in favour of Varushka over the Imperial Orcs, and Karsk became part of Varushka. The Senate recorded that the hold was not secure. The Thule still controlled three of Karsk's seven regions, and losing a single further region would mean the Empire lost the territory.

n.Imperial Orcs: The Imperial Orcs were the other nation put forward to receive Karsk but received no votes, so the territory went to Varushka.
n.Thule: The Thule lost Karsk as a territory but still held three of its seven regions, enough to threaten the Empire's grip on it.
n.Varushka: Varushka gained Karsk unanimously, 26 votes to 0, but took on a fragile territory that would be lost if a single further region fell.

t.Karsk: Karsk was formally made part of Varushka, though the Thule still held three of its seven regions and the Imperial claim remained precarious.

r.Karsk/Lestasny: Lestasny was where the heroic opportunity took place that led to the conquest of Karsk.

Construct Barrens Spy Network.d: The motion to create a spy network in The Barrens passed in principle by 23 votes to 2. The commission cost 10 wains of weirwood, took three months to build, and carried an upkeep of 2 thrones per season from the Senate budget. Hector de Rondell provided the 10 wains of weirwood after the Spring Equinox 378YE, and the network was completed, giving the Empire a means of gathering intelligence in the Druj-held territory. It survived for several years before the Druj destroyed it following the Summer Solstice 382YE.

n.Druj: The Empire planted a spy network in Druj-held lands to watch their movements, and the Druj eventually found it and destroyed it after the Summer Solstice 382YE.

t.The Barrens: An Imperial spy network was built in The Barrens while the Druj held it, and it operated there until the Druj destroyed it following the Summer Solstice 382YE.

Construct a Marcher graveyard in Holberg.d: The motion, proposed by the senator for Temeschwar and seconded by the senator for Semmerholm, called for a cemetery in Holberg for the Marchers raised as husks. A Marcher graveyard involves importing soil from the Marches and planting Marcher apple trees. No funds were requested and the motion carried in principle by 26 votes to none. The graveyard was quickly built in the Holfried region of Holberg.

n.Druj: Mentioned in passing: the Druj are not named in the motion; they are linked only because they held part of Holberg, where the graveyard for Marchers raised as husks was built.
n.The League: The motion was brought by the League senators for Temeschwar and Semmerholm, and the graveyard was raised in Holberg, a League territory then partly held by the Druj.

t.Holberg: Holberg, then divided between the League and the Druj, gained a Marcher graveyard planted with Marcher apple trees in imported Marches soil, to lay to rest Marchers raised as husks.

r.Holberg/Holfried: Holfried became the site of the completed Marcher graveyard, built quickly after the Senate approved the motion.

Construct mana repository in Morrow.d: Proposed by the senator for Morrow and seconded by Karov, the motion sought to develop Morrow's mana crystal capacity by creating a sinecure, the Phoenix Caverns, at a cost of 10 wains of mithril. Its holder, the Augur of the Phoenix Caverns, would have managed the caverns and been appointed unanimously by the Urizen senators, with a greater majority nomination by the Senate as the fallback. The Senate voted 8 for and 18 against in principle, so the motion was defeated and the facility was not built.

n.Urizen: Urizen lost a proposed sinecure that its own senators would have filled, along with a new source of crystal mana in its lands, when the Senate rejected the motion.

t.Morrow: Morrow's senator proposed the Phoenix Caverns to expand the territory's mana crystal capacity, but the motion failed and no facility was built there.

Contact the Lasambrian orcs.d: Proposed by the senator for Therunin and seconded by Upwold, the motion called for contact with the Lasambrian orcs to discuss two things: their removing themselves from Segura, and a possible alliance against the Jotun. It passed in principle by 25 votes to none. In response, attempts were made to send Winged Messengers to the Lasambrian orcs. The page records only that these attempts were made, not whether contact was achieved or what the orcs replied.

n.Jotun: The Senate sought to turn the Lasambrian orcs against the Jotun, proposing an alliance aimed squarely at them.

t.Segura: The Senate hoped to persuade the Lasambrian orcs occupying Segura to withdraw, and Winged Messengers were sent to raise the matter with them.

Disburse funds for strategic rituals.d: In Spring 378YE the Senator for Redoubt raised a motion, seconded by Madruga, to disburse funds for casting strategic rituals on armies. 25 Thrones were disbursed to Probus, Senator for Redoubt. In Autumn 378YE Morrow proposed a similar motion, seconded by Sarvos, to fund the purchase of mana for strategic military purposes. It passed in principle at 95 Thrones, which were disbursed to Ariadne of the Auric Horizon, Proxy Senator for Morrow. Both motions intended the money to buy crystal mana for rituals that would benefit the Empire and the Imperial armies on a strategic level.

n.Urizen: Urizen's senators for Redoubt and Morrow sponsored both motions and received all 120 Thrones, placing responsibility for buying mana for the Empire's strategic rituals in Urizen hands.

t.Morrow: Morrow proposed the Autumn 378YE motion, and its Proxy Senator, Ariadne of the Auric Horizon, received 95 Thrones to buy mana for strategic military rituals.
t.Redoubt: Redoubt raised the Spring 378YE motion, and its Senator, Probus, received 25 Thrones to fund strategic rituals cast on Imperial armies.

Propose treaty of limited warfare to the.d: Proposed by the senator for Bregasland and seconded by the senator for Mitwold, the motion sought to open communications with the Jotun to limit the war to Mournwold and Liathaven. It would have suggested an amendment to the Jotun ceasefire then in place. The motion was defeated at the in-principle stage, with 7 votes for and 20 against, so no such proposal was made to the Jotun.

n.Jotun: The Jotun would have been approached with a proposal to confine fighting with the Empire to Mournwold and Liathaven, but the Senate voted the idea down, so no offer was sent.

t.Liathaven: Liathaven, held by the Jotun, was named as one of the two territories where fighting would have been confined, had the failed motion passed.
t.Mournwold: Mournwold, held by the Jotun, would have been one of only two territories where war with the Jotun continued under the proposed amendment, which the Senate rejected.
